meta.name: CampusRun Console
meta.decisionDefinition: Keep the full UI design, label every feature as existing/adapter/new, and list assumptions and risks.
meta.purpose: Implement a local Android control console for the 7.3.92 protocol suite. Vue3 renders the UI in a WebView; Kotlin hosts the native bridge; Chaquopy runs Python 3.12 in-process; Python executes the protocol. No backend service, no listening port.
meta.uiStructureNote: navigation / screens / repoLayout 仍保留 4 Tab / 7 页 / TokenImportPage 的旧结构，供协议与功能追溯；页面结构与交互以 UI设计说明.md 2.0.0 为准（3 Tab / 6 页）。实现契约见 UI实现规格.md。

decisions: Android only; iOS is out of scope.
Deliver an installable APK; the UI is a Vue3 app rendered by Android WebView.
No backend, no local HTTP server, no Termux, no PC dependency.
Login uses an in-app manual GeeTest v4 slider rendered in WebView.
First release covers login/account/profile, policy/fence/checkpoints, and the full run chain.
History list, calendar, ads, ranks, multi-account, automatic captcha, and iOS are not in v1.
Visual direction defaults to a dark task-console theme.
Every feature must be labeled existing, adapter, or new in this spec and in the human doc.
goals: Operate the 7.3.92 protocol from a mobile UI instead of CLI flags.
Run entirely on the Android device with no backend service.
Complete login, token management, and profile retrieval.
Display run rules, valid time windows, face-check status, geofences, and official checkpoints.
Configure distance and duration, preview the synthesized route without network writes, then execute the full chain with staged progress.
Show rrid, validity, metrics, signature summary, OBS status, and support recheck and trace export.
nonGoals: No history list, calendar, ads, ranks, or multi-account in v1.
No server-side account pooling, proxy, or cloud sync.
No automatic GeeTest solving in v1.
No real map tiles; trajectory is rendered as a self-contained SVG.
No background service; the run must stay in the foreground.
constraints: Python must be 3.12 because running/client.py uses nested-quote f-strings at lines 184 and 225.
Chaquopy 3.12 supports only arm64-v8a and x86_64; no 32-bit ABIs.
Browser-only execution cannot work: CORS blocks signed requests and browsers cannot run CPython or Playwright.
Capacitor https://localhost is a WebViewAssetLoader virtual origin, not a listening server.
The app still needs internet access for the target API, OBS, and GeeTest.
Do not embed secrets, salts, captcha IDs, tokens, or passwords in docs or frontend constants.
The repository path contains Chinese characters; build with UTF-8-safe settings or an ASCII build path.
All bridge methods must be whitelisted and validate inputs on both Kotlin and Python sides.

signing.release: Self-signed .jks keystore; back up the keystore and passwords

notes: Pin exact versions at M0 after verifying Capacitor/AGP/Chaquopy compatibility.
Use hash routing to avoid WebView deep-link issues.
Do not use external fonts, CDNs, analytics, or crash reporting.

responsibilities: Pages, forms, navigation, charts, SVG trajectory
Deliver native events to JS listeners
Run protocol work on a single-thread executor
Store token and device profile securely
Initialize Chaquopy and forward progress events
Load app_bridge.py and the vendored protocol package
Convert Python values to Java/Kotlin values
Trajectory synthesis, signatures, OBS upload, settlement, recheck

verification: Run netstat/ss on the device or inspect the APK; there must be no listening socket owned by the app.
There is no FastAPI/Flask/Node server process.

responsibilities.doesNot: Protocol requests, Python execution, native storage

responsibilities.does: Package web assets, create WebView, provide JS-to-Kotlin bridge and plugin runtime
responsibilities.doesNot: Know about Python or execute protocol logic

responsibilities.does: Receive calls, validate params, thread dispatch, secure storage, call Python, emit events
responsibilities.doesNot: Render UI or implement protocol crypto

responsibilities.does: Run CPython in the app process and bridge Kotlin/Python values
responsibilities.doesNot: Provide any network API or server

responsibilities.does: Protocol, crypto, signatures, trajectory, OBS, settlement, recheck
responsibilities.doesNot: Render UI or manage Android lifecycle

conventions.naming: camelCase in JS/Kotlin; snake_case in Python
conventions.timestamps: Unix epoch milliseconds unless the field name ends with Sec
conventions.pace: seconds per kilometer when computed by the UI
conventions.errors: Business errors resolve with {ok:false,error}; unexpected failures reject with a code and message
conventions.threading: All Python calls run on a single-thread executor; JS never blocks
conventions.size: Downsample large point arrays before returning to JS; keep full artifacts in Python memory

methods.name: initialize
sideEffects: Load token and device profile from SecureStore
If a token exists, create SportClient792 without validating it
notes: Called once at app boot.
Device profile must be stable across launches.

methods.name: prepareLogin
sideEffects: Creates a LoginClient with the persisted device_config
notes: check_gee_use data:true means captcha can be skipped.
captchaId is read at runtime from login/config.py; do not hardcode it in the frontend.

methods.name: submitLogin

params.name: password
params.notes: Kept in memory only; never logged or persisted

sideEffects: Store uid, unid, token in SecureStore
notes: Do not call LoginClient.login(); it invokes GeetestV4Solver and subprocess/Playwright.
Order: gee_validate then submit_login.
Password must never appear in logs or error payloads.

methods.name: getProfile
notes: CLI equivalent: --profile.

methods.name: getSemesterProgress
notes: Method exists in SportClient792 but is not exposed by the CLI.
Treat response shape as unverified until tested on a real account.

methods.name: getPolicy
notes: CLI equivalent: --rules --mode.

methods.name: getFences
notes: Fence polygon points are in GeoFenceArea.polygon_points.
Fence check_points may be legacy; official live points come from getCheckpoints.

methods.name: getCheckpoints

params.name: mode
params.notes: Only scoring runs (mode 1) support checkpoint queries.

sideEffects: May allocate a run uuid and checkpoints; does not upload a record
notes: CLI equivalent: --checkpoints.
If school has multiple run areas, surface a selector; do not silently pick one.
Do not call for mode 6.

methods.name: previewRun
sideEffects: May read run policy, geofences, and official checkpoints
notes: Timestamps are examples based on current server time; executeRun re-prepares immediately before submission.
Return a downsampled gpsPoints array to JS; keep the full array in PreparedRun.
SignatureSummary must not expose the salt or full canonical string with secrets; expose field names and masked values where needed.

methods.name: executeRun

params.name: preparedId
params.notes: If provided, reuse cached preparation when it is still fresh; otherwise re-prepare.

sideEffects: Telemetry startup/pv and datacollection/pv when unid is present
notes: dryRun=true stops after prepare and local consistency checks; no write requests.
Events are emitted via runProgress and runLog.
After OBS starts, cancellation is rejected.
If OBS succeeds but save/record fails, result must show a partial state.
If recheck fails, isValid must be null and the UI must not show success.

methods.name: cancelRun
sideEffects: Sets a cooperative cancel event checked before OBS and before settle
notes: Cannot abort an in-flight urllib request.
After OBS starts, return CANCEL_TOO_LATE.

methods.name: recheckRecord
notes: A failed recheck is unknown, not valid.

methods.name: getRuntimeInfo
notes: Used by Settings and debug panels.

methods.name: logout
sideEffects: Clear uid, unid, token from SecureStore
notes: Do not clear the device profile unless the user explicitly resets it.

methods.name: exportTrace
sideEffects: Serializes the current run trace; no network
notes: Redact token, password, captcha payload, full device ID, and secrets.
Vue can use the system share sheet or a download path.

events.name: runProgress
notes: Emit on every stage transition.
Percent should be monotonic within a run.

events.name: runLog
notes: Redact secrets before emitting.

events.name: authExpired
notes: Emitted when a request returns an authentication failure.
Vue clears the session and redirects to /login.

PreparedRun, SubmissionArtifacts, RunEvent, Warning, and serialization helpers

changes: Split execute_full_run into prepare_run and submit_prepared_run.
Add event_callback and cancel_event parameters with defaults.
Keep execute_full_run behavior and signature compatible.
Expose OBS status and prepared artifacts in the result/raw payload.
Add build_submission_artifacts returning save_record, obs_payload, object_key, sign_map, signature, original_sign.
Keep build_submission_payload as a compatibility wrapper returning the original 3-tuple.
Add PreparedRun, SubmissionArtifacts, RunEvent, Warning, ObsResult if not placed in app_bridge_models.py.
Extend RunningSubmissionResult with optional fields for stages, obs, signature, recheck, trace_id, warnings.
Pass device_config through to subsystem clients.

steps: If needCaptcha, wait for the JS geetest payload; construct GeetestResult(captcha_id, lot_number, pass_token, gen_time, captcha_output)
forbidden: Do not log password, token, or captcha payload.

rules: Generate DeviceId once and persist it in EncryptedSharedPreferences.
Pass the same device_config to SportClient792 and LoginClient.
Do not regenerate DeviceId on every launch.
Do not expose the full DeviceId in UI or logs; show a masked prefix.

vendoring.manifest: Write a SHA-256 manifest of copied files for traceability.

compatibility: CLI must continue to work with the old execute_full_run signature and progress_callback.
Python 3.12 syntax must not be downgraded; pin Chaquopy to 3.12.
Do not import or call Playwright, Node, or subprocess in the app path.

screens.title: 登录
screens.purpose: Authenticate with username/password, complete manual GeeTest, persist token.

actions.label: 登录
actions.calls: prepareLogin then CaptchaSheet if needCaptcha then submitLogin

acceptance: Empty username/password is rejected locally.
checkGeeUse response controls captcha visibility.
A successful manual slide yields lot_number, captcha_output, pass_token, gen_time.
Token is persisted; password is not.
Failure shows a retry and the token-import fallback.

screens.title: 控制台
screens.purpose: Show account, semester progress, current rule summary, readiness checklist, and primary action.
acceptance: Checklist states are derived, not hardcoded.
If semester progress fails, the rest of the console still renders.
Primary action is disabled until logged in.

screens.title: 规则与围栏
screens.purpose: Select mode, inspect rules, face-check status, geofences, and official checkpoints.

actions.label: 计分跑/自由跑
actions.calls: getPolicy(mode); clear checkpoints when mode changes

acceptance: Mode switch refetches the rule.
Face-check enabled shows a prominent warning.
Fence polygon is rendered from polygon_points.
Checkpoint failure is shown explicitly; scoring runs do not silently use a local fallback.
Multiple run areas produce a selector or actionable error.

screens.title: 跑步配置
screens.purpose: Set distance/time, validate against rules, preview route, choose dry-run or submit.
acceptance: Pace is computed from distance/time and shown in min/km.
Out-of-range pace/step shows warnings but does not hard-block.
Preview makes no OBS/save requests.
Dry-run returns a preview-like result and no writes.
Distance/time must be positive integers.

screens.title: 运行中
screens.purpose: Show the six internal stage IDs grouped into five UI steps, live logs, cancellation availability, and errors.
acceptance: Stages update from events, not timers.
Cancel is disabled once the obs stage starts.
Time-backfill is explained in the UI.
Logs redact secrets.
The screen keeps the device awake while running.

screens.title: 跑步结果
screens.purpose: Show rrid, validity, metrics, signature summary, OBS status, recheck, and trace export.
acceptance: Validity is only shown when the record is confirmed.
Recheck failure shows unknown, not success.
OBS success + settlement failure is shown as partial.
Export redacts secrets.

screens.title: 我的
screens.purpose: Show token status, stable device ID, versions, session reset, disclaimer.
acceptance: Token is masked; no full token display.
Device ID is masked except a short prefix/suffix.
Logout keeps device ID and clears session.
Version rows show app, protocol, and Python versions.

guards: If auth.status is not loggedIn, redirect to /login except /login and /login/token.
If a run is active and the user tries to leave /run/running, show a confirm sheet.
Android back on /run/running must not silently abandon the run.
backBehavior: Login: back exits the app after confirm.
Tabs: back returns to console tab; second back exits.
Running: back opens the cancel/leave confirmation.
Result: back returns to run setup with the previous parameters.

guards: Cancel is allowed only before the obs stage starts.
RECHECK_UNKNOWN ends the flow but isValid must be null.
failed and cancelled must preserve the stage/log history for the result screen.

motion.reducedMotion: disable route draw, pulse, and progress shimmer

trajectorySvg.normalization: fit all points into the viewBox with 24px padding
trajectorySvg.pathColor: speed gradient from accent2 (slow) to accent (fast)
trajectorySvg.downsample: keep corners and checkpoints; cap at 600 rendered points

accessibility: Status must use icon + text, not color alone.
Focus ring must be visible for keyboard and switch access.
Do not rely on hover for any action.

webview.mainPage: local assets only; no remote URLs

compliance: No multi-account, paid proxy, or server-side pooling.
Session files and traces must stay local unless explicitly exported by the user.

prerequisites: Android Studio with SDK 35 and build tools
Android 7.0+ arm64 device or x86_64 emulator
At least 25-40 GB free disk and 16 GB RAM recommended

gradle.buildPython: Absolute path to a Python 3.12 executable on the build machine

chaquopy.dependencies: Protocol suite uses only the Python standard library; no pip packages required

signing.release: Create a .jks with keytool; configure signingConfigs; back up the keystore and passwords offline
signing.updateRule: Same package name, higher versionCode, same keystore; otherwise uninstall/reinstall and lose the token

install: Transfer app-debug.apk or app-release.apk to the phone.
Allow install from unknown sources for the file manager/browser.
Open the app and complete the disclaimer/login.
build.sizeEstimate: 30-50 MB depending on ABI and Python stdlib packaging
encoding: The repository path contains Chinese characters.
Prefer an ASCII build path, or set JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8.

unit: Distance/time validation: positive integers; reject NaN/Infinity/booleans.
Rule warning parser: speedTop/speedBottom variants; stepTop/stepBottom '不限'.
SVG normalization: bounding box, padding, degenerate single-point route.
Masking: phone, token, device ID, uid.
contract: Mock ProtocolBridge implements every method and event.
Web dev build runs with the mock bridge without Android.
All bridge methods match the TypeScript interface.
instrumented: APK installs and launches on a real arm64 device.
No listening socket owned by the app.
Manual GeeTest flow reaches the login endpoint.
Dry-run completes with no OBS/save network calls.
A real execute returns rrid and recheck detail.
golden: Same mode/distance/time input produces the same route shape and totals as the Python builder.
Signature field count is 31 for the save/record payload.
Track visits all fixed checkpoints within 0.1m in validation.
ui: Bottom tab bar respects safe-area insets.
Status uses icon + text, not color alone.
Error, empty, loading, and partial states exist for every data screen.
security: No token/password/captcha payload in logs or export trace.
Bridge rejects unknown methods and invalid params.
Captcha WebView does not expose the main bridge.
manual: Verify GeeTest in WebView on the target phone.
Verify TLS/CA on the target phone.
Verify behavior when the app is backgrounded during a run.
Verify a 3 km / 1060 s dry-run and a real run on a test account.

traceability.notes: Existing solver is Node+Playwright; WebView manual integration is new.
Fallback if WebView GeeTest is blocked.
CLI does not expose it; verify response.

traceability.feature: 控制台 UI / 检查清单

traceability.notes: Need UI selection or actionable error.
Six internal stage IDs; UI groups settle + recheck into step 5.

assumptions: get_semester_progress works and returns a stable SemesterInfo.
GeeTest v4 works inside Android WebView without being blocked.
speedTop/speedBottom formatting is consistent enough for a non-blocking warning.
Official checkpoint retrieval works for the user's school/account; multiple areas can be resolved by the user.
Face check is disabled for the user's school; if enabled, the run may be invalid.
Chaquopy TLS/CA works on the target device.
The server accepts timestamp-backfilled runs without a real 17-minute wait.
A stable DeviceId does not trigger additional risk control compared with the CLI's random DeviceId.

risks.risk: GeeTest blocks WebView or detects automation
risks.mitigation: Test early; fall back to gt4-index.html + Android JSInterface; keep PC token import.
M0 hello-world; pin Chaquopy 17.1 + Python 3.12 + Capacitor 7; use official compatibility tables.
ASCII build path or JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8; UTF-8 source files.
Test on device; explicit system CA or certifi fallback.
Detect auth errors, clear session, redirect to login.
UI area selector or actionable error.
Keep screen awake; warn; no foreground service in v1.
Personal/authorized accounts only; dry-run for development; no multi-account.

acceptanceCriteria: APK installs and launches on Android 7.0+ arm64.
The app owns no listening port and starts no local HTTP server.
Login triggers checkGeeUse and shows GeeTest only when needed.
Manual GeeTest completes and login succeeds.
Token is encrypted at rest and restored after restart.
Policy page shows rules, valid times, face-check status, fence polygon, and official checkpoints.
Preview generates route, buckets, and signature summary with no OBS/save requests.
Dry-run performs no write requests; logs prove it.
Execute shows stage progress and returns rrid and validity.
Recheck returns a record; recheck failure shows unknown.
Network, auth, captcha, OBS, and settlement failures show actionable errors and do not crash.
Cancel works before OBS; after OBS it returns CANCEL_TOO_LATE.
360x800 and 412x915 have no horizontal scroll; touch targets >= 44dp; tab bar respects safe areas.
Logs and exported traces contain no token, password, captcha payload, or full DeviceId.
assembleRelease produces a signed APK; the same keystore can update it.
Every existing/adapter/new label in this spec matches the implementation and tests.
implementationOrder: 1. Create Vue + Capacitor app; build and open on Android.
2. Add Chaquopy; sync Python; expose a ping method; verify APK size and Python 3.12.
3. Add ProtocolPlugin skeleton, single-thread executor, JSON conversion, error envelope.
6. Implement prepareLogin/submitLogin and manual GeeTest page.
9. Implement getCheckpoints and SVG fence/checkpoint rendering.
12. Implement executeRun, structured events, running page, cancel.
13. Implement result page, recheck, signature/OBS summaries, exportTrace.
15. Add tests, error states, accessibility, release signing.

cliParity.ui: Implicit in run stages; runtime info

errorCodes.handling: Show error; do not silently fall back for scoring runs

glossary.definition: Android's embedded web renderer; not a browser app, no address bar, no server.
Hybrid app framework that packages web assets into a native shell and provides a JS-to-Kotlin bridge.
Android native programming language used for the shell, bridge, secure storage, and Chaquopy startup.
Python runtime for Android that embeds CPython in the app process via JNI.
In-process message channel between JS and Kotlin; not HTTP and not a server.
Python dataclass holding a fully synthesized run ready for preview or submission.
Prepare and validate locally without OBS/save/recheck writes.
The protocol sets startTime = stopTime - totalTime instead of waiting in real time.
